$comment: Agent-neutral MCP server definitions for Watch Face Total View. This is the single source
of truth; ai_tooling/setup.ps1 generates the per-agent config from it, because every
tool spells the same thing differently. Each agent's file, top-level key and
${REPO_ROOT} is replaced with this clone's absolute path at generation time.
Every generated file is gitignored, so absolute paths are correct there and
sidestep the fact that path variables differ per tool too (${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}
vs ${workspaceFolder} vs nothing at all in Cursor).
A server published on npm is started through ai_tooling/npm-mcp.js with an exact
scripts/setup-tools.ps1 installs that version into ai_tooling/mcp-packages.
skipAgents lists agents that already get the server another way - adding it
again would run a second, duplicate process.
Known servers and how to declare them: documentation/mcp.md.
